temple-wood-works.title: Temple Wood Works
paragraphs: Let us come together to ensure that the carpentry profession thrives, and future generations carry this proud tradition forward with honor and dignity.

Temple Wood Works is dedicated to preserving the rich tradition of handcrafted wooden art rooted in spirituality and culture. We specialize in creating intricately designed wooden toys, idols, temple carvings, and decor items that reflect the essence of Indian heritage. Our mission is to promote eco-friendly craftsmanship while supporting local artisans and traditional woodcraft techniques. From the globally renownedKondapalliandEtikoppaka toysto sacredtemple sculptures, we bring history and devotion into every piece. At Temple Wood Works, we believe in crafting not just products—but stories of peace, devotion, and timeless beauty that resonate with every generation.

Making toys is a form of new ideas for peace of mind, happiness and spiritualityIn this country we should encourage only wooden toys in the hands of children to eradicate the demon of plastic. The government still needs to encourage the use of wooden toys and the making of toys to make the Indian heritage clear to our future generations. Through our association, we are not only encouraging toy manufacturers but also providing respect and incentives to them on behalf of the government. On this occasion, we remind you that Madhavamala dolls were given as gifts to world leaders in our state, Kondapalli, Etikoppaka dolls are being bought by the whole world today.

indias-biggest-skill-competition.title: India's Biggest Skill Competition
paragraphs: Let us come together to ensure that the carpentry profession thrives, and future generations carry this proud tradition forward with honor and dignity.

In collaboration withSkill India, we are working to empower the carpentry profession in Andhra Pradesh and pass on this invaluable trade to future generations. The carpentry community is the backbone of many industries, and ensuring that they remain competitive and skilled in modern techniques is essential for their growth and development.

We aim to help carpenters embracemodern knowledgeand equip them with the expertise needed to operatenew machinery and technologies. The government is providing valuableincentivesandresourcesthrough initiatives likeSkill India, and we are dedicated to making sure that these benefits reach the skilled carpenters of Andhra Pradesh.

Together, we can help our carpenters compete on the global stage and make our nation proud. By working hand-in-hand, we can empower every carpenter to confidently say, “I am a proud carpenter,” and be respected for their skill, craftsmanship, and contribution to the country’s development.
